title: Artificial_intelligence_controversies
summary:
Artificial intelligence controversies encompass the major debates surrounding AI, particularly during the AI boom of the late 2010s and 2020s. Detractors have argued that AI presents dangers and challenges involving ethics, plagiarism and theft, fraud, safety and alignment, environmental impacts, unemployment, misinformation, artificial superintelligence and existential risks. On the other side, advocates of AI have emphasized its potential to solve complex problems and improve the quality of life of humans.

Notable incidents include the Microsoft Tay chatbot controversy of 2016, when Microsoft released a chatbot designed to mimic the language patterns of a 19-year-old American girl that began posting racist, sexist, and inflammatory tweets after Twitter users deliberately taught it offensive phrases. In November 2023, OpenAI's board ousted co-founder Sam Altman citing loss of confidence in his leadership, precipitated by employee concerns about AI safety and allegations of abusive behavior; Altman was reinstated on November 22 after pressure from employees and investors.

On May 30, 2023, the Center for AI Safety released a statement signed by hundreds of AI experts warning that mitigating extinction risk from AI should be a global priority. Signatories included Geoffrey Hinton, Yoshua Bengio, Sam Altman, Demis Hassabis, and Bill Gates. The Voiceverse NFT scandal of 2022 involved voice actor Troy Baker's partnership with a blockchain-based AI voice cloning company that had used the free 15.ai project to generate samples and falsely marketed them as proprietary technology.

In December 2025, McDonald's Netherlands released an AI-generated TV commercial that received negative reception over its use of generative AI and cynical depiction of the holiday season, and was pulled within three days. The Wikipedia category for AI controversies also includes articles on the Google Gemini image generation controversy, the Taylor Swift deepfake pornography controversy, and other notable incidents.
